judge.rationale: Agreement is limited to a substantial core of PTMA, PABPC1, CKS2, FTH1, several ribosomal proteins, TUBB4B/TUBA1C, ALDOA, and PKM supporting a biosynthetic proliferative state, while B/C add extensive cell-cycle, histone, OXPHOS, proteostasis, redox, and lineage contributors and D materially deemphasizes histones and canonical cell-cycle effectors, leaving more than half of the complete molecular content nonshared and invoking the shared-minority ceiling of 4.
